name: How does a luxury valuation differ from a standard home appraisal?

mainEntity.name: How does a luxury valuation differ from a standard home appraisal?

acceptedAnswer.text: A luxury valuation goes beyond a standard appraisal by incorporating a deeper analysis of unique, high-value attributes and market nuances specific to the luxury segment. While a standard appraisal focuses on comparable sales, a luxury valuation considers specialized factors like architectural significance, bespoke amenities, celebrity provenance, or waterfront views in areas like Key Biscayne. The process involves a more qualitative assessment alongside quantitative data to capture the full, often intangible, value of an elite property.
acceptedAnswer.description: A luxury valuation assesses unique, high-value attributes beyond a standard appraisal, considering specialized factors like architectural significance or waterfront views.
